data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure closely: EDGAR ticker search and autocomplete, a 10-K filter, the latest filing date, then HQ, employees and CEO from the Wikipedia infobox, then the email with the exact subject and body templates, all with the right parameters. It loses points because it says Send where the true workflow says not to send and to click Discard, it skips noting the period of the 10-K, and it uses full-text search refinements instead of the company filings page filter.
